environment: staging, organisation QA-GEO, en-GB, features.unbranded_analysis=true, prompt pool 953/1000
write_guard: context.route on **/geo/api/** blocking non-GET; allow-listed draft-building POSTs: analysis/discover-categories, analysis/translate-category, questions/adapt-batch. No analysis created. Guard removed with context.unrouteAll() at the end.

results.title: New Analysis opens Analysis Type with two cards and nothing selected

steps.title: Given the user is on the GEO dashboard of organisation T
steps.expected: The dashboard is displayed with New Analysis available

steps.title: When the user clicks New Analysis
steps.expected: The wizard opens on step 1 "Analysis Type"; the stepper lists 5 steps: Analysis Type, Brand & Country, Categories, Prompts, Review

steps.title: Then two cards "Brand analysis" and "Unbranded analysis" are displayed
steps.expected: Both cards are shown, each with a description of what it measures

steps.title: And no card is selected
steps.expected: Neither card is selected and the primary action (Continue) is disabled

results.notes: Wizard opens on step 1 'Analysis Type' with 5 steps (Analysis Type, Brand & Country, Categories, Prompts, Review). Cards 'Brand analysis' (Default, 'Track how AI engines present your brand against its field.' + 3 points) and 'Unbranded analysis' (Advanced, 'Measure an industry or topic instead of a brand. Football, car insurance, frozen food.' + 3 points). Both radios unchecked, Continue disabled, no mode pill in the product bar.

results.title: Flag OFF: the wizard keeps four steps with no Analysis Type step and no mode pill
results.skip_reason: SKIP while the unbranded flag is ON on staging: run only with the flag OFF (GEO-1241 AC1b). GET /geo/api/v1/auth/me returned features.unbranded_analysis = true on 2026-10-20; the screenshots show the flag ON wizard as evidence.

steps.title: Given the user is on the GEO dashboard of organisation T
steps.expected: The dashboard is displayed with New Analysis available

steps.title: When the user clicks New Analysis
steps.expected: The wizard opens directly on Brand & Country

steps.title: Then the stepper lists four steps
steps.expected: Brand & Country, Categories, Prompts, Review; no "Analysis Type" step

steps.title: And no mode pill is shown in the product bar
steps.expected: Neither "Brand analysis" nor "Unbranded analysis" is shown in the product bar

steps.title: And Brand & Country asks for a brand as today
steps.expected: The brand search field is displayed; no topic field

results.title: Selecting a card enables Continue and the mode pill shows the mode

steps.title: Given the user is on the Analysis Type step with nothing selected
steps.expected: Continue is disabled

steps.title: When the user selects the "Brand analysis" card
steps.expected: The card is shown selected

steps.title: Then the primary action is enabled
steps.expected: Continue is enabled

steps.title: And the mode pill shows the mode
steps.expected: The product bar pill reads "Brand analysis"

steps.title: When the user selects the "Unbranded analysis" card instead
steps.expected: Only the Unbranded analysis card is selected; Continue stays enabled

steps.title: Then the mode pill shows the new mode
steps.expected: The product bar pill reads "Unbranded analysis"

results.notes: Nothing selected: Continue disabled. Brand analysis clicked: radio BRAND checked, Continue enabled, product bar pill 'Brand analysis'. Unbranded analysis clicked: only UNBRANDED checked, Continue enabled, pill 'Unbranded analysis'.

results.title: The mode pill stays the same on every later step

steps.title: Given the user selected "Unbranded analysis" on Analysis Type and continued
steps.expected: Topic & Country is displayed and the pill reads "Unbranded analysis"

steps.title: When the user fills Topic & Country and continues to Categories
steps.expected: Categories is displayed and the pill still reads "Unbranded analysis"

steps.title: And the user continues to Prompts and then Review
steps.expected: The pill reads "Unbranded analysis" on Prompts and on Review

steps.title: Then the pill never changed without a mode switch
steps.expected: The pill text is identical on every step from step 1 to Review

results.notes: Pill read 'Unbranded analysis' on Topic & Country, Categories (topic 'Postal services', GB (EN) + FR (FR)), Prompts and Review. Identical text on every step.

results.title: Unbranded analysis turns step 2 into Topic & Country asking for an industry or topic

steps.title: Given the user is on the Analysis Type step
steps.expected: The two cards are displayed

steps.title: When the user selects "Unbranded analysis" and continues
steps.expected: Step 2 opens

steps.title: Then step 2 is labelled "Topic & Country"
steps.expected: The stepper and the step title read "Topic & Country", not "Brand & Country"

steps.title: And the step asks for an industry or topic instead of a brand
steps.expected: A topic text field is displayed; there is no brand search, no brand logo and no brand website field

steps.title: And the markets block and Language for AI Insights are displayed as in a brand analysis
steps.expected: The markets block (country, language) and Language for AI Insights are shown below the topic field

results.notes: Stepper step 2 and h1 read 'Topic & Country'. Only input: #wizard-topic-input (placeholder 'e.g. Car insurance'); no brand search, no logo image, no website field. Markets block ('Which countries do you want to analyse?') and 'Language for AI Insights' shown below the topic field.

results.title: Topic & Country asks "What industry or topic are you analysing?" with the topic helper

steps.title: Given the user selected "Unbranded analysis" on Analysis Type
steps.expected: The Unbranded analysis card is selected

steps.title: When the user continues to Topic & Country
steps.expected: Topic & Country is displayed

steps.title: Then the field asks the topic question
steps.expected: "What industry or topic are you analysing?" is displayed as the field question

steps.title: And a helper states that the topic frames the analysis and is never measured
steps.expected: The helper is shown under the field (design copy: "The topic frames the analysis. It is never measured. What gets measured is whichever brands the AI answers name.")

results.notes: Field label 'What industry or topic are you analysing?'; helper 'The topic frames the analysis. It is never measured. What gets measured is whichever brands the AI answers name.' (matches the design copy and en-gb topic.helper).

results.title: An empty topic shows a red border and a message naming the field

steps.title: Given the user is on Topic & Country of an unbranded analysis with the topic empty
steps.expected: The topic field is empty

steps.title: When the user tries to continue
steps.expected: The click on "Discover Categories" does not leave the step

steps.title: Then the topic field shows a red border
steps.expected: The topic field border is red

steps.title: And a message naming the field is displayed
steps.expected: A message under the field names the topic (industry or topic) field

steps.title: When the user types a topic
steps.expected: The red border and the message disappear and the user can continue

results.notes: Market GB (EN), topic empty, click 'Discover Categories': stays on Topic & Country, input border red (border-red-500), aria-invalid=true, message 'Enter the industry or topic you want to analyse.' shown below the field (after the helper). After typing 'Postal services': red border and message gone, aria-invalid=false, Discover Categories enabled.

results.title: Switching from Unbranded to Brand after step 1 asks for a confirmation and clears the later steps

steps.title: Given the user created an unbranded scope up to the Categories step
steps.data: Topic: "Postal services"; markets GB (EN), FR (FR); categories C1, C2 discovered
steps.expected: Categories shows C1 and C2 and the pill reads "Unbranded analysis"

steps.title: When the user goes back to Analysis Type
steps.data: Click step "Analysis Type" in the stepper
steps.expected: Analysis Type shows Unbranded analysis selected

steps.title: And the user selects "Brand analysis"
steps.expected: A confirmation opens

steps.title: Then the confirmation states what is cleared
steps.expected: The text states that the brand or topic, the markets, the categories and the prompts are cleared

steps.title: When the user confirms
steps.expected: The pill reads "Brand analysis" and the user continues to Brand & Country

steps.title: Then the later steps are cleared
steps.expected: Brand & Country has no brand and none of the previous markets; Categories and Prompts hold none of the previous categories and prompts

results.notes: From Categories (topic 'Postal services', GB + FR, Package Delivery + Mail Services, plus Courier Services added by TC-013), stepper Analysis Type shows Unbranded selected; selecting Brand opens 'Switch the analysis type?' - 'Switching the mode clears your brand or topic, your markets, your categories and your prompts. Nothing is saved: this cannot be undone. Cancel to keep your current setup.' Switch type: pill 'Brand analysis'; Brand & Country has an empty brand search and no market; Categories/Prompts/Review steps locked (aria-disabled). After brand Decathlon discovery, Categories show only Outdoor Gear / Sports Apparel and Prompts 70 Decathlon prompts, none of the previous categories or prompts.

results.title: Cancelling the mode switch keeps the mode and every choice

steps.title: Given the user created an unbranded scope up to the Prompts step
steps.data: Topic: "Postal services"; markets GB (EN), FR (FR); categories C1, C2
steps.expected: Prompts shows the suggested prompts and the pill reads "Unbranded analysis"

steps.title: When the user goes back to Analysis Type and selects "Brand analysis"
steps.expected: The confirmation opens

steps.title: And the user cancels the confirmation
steps.expected: The confirmation closes

steps.title: Then the mode is unchanged

steps.title: And every choice is kept
steps.expected: Topic & Country still shows "Postal services" and both markets; Categories shows C1 and C2; Prompts shows the same prompts and the same ticks

results.notes: From Prompts (120 rows, 41 ticked after the TC-015/016/017 manipulations of the same session), Analysis Type -> Brand analysis opens the confirmation; Cancel closes it. Unbranded still selected, pill 'Unbranded analysis'. Topic & Country: 'Postal services', United Kingdom English (EN) and France French (FR). Categories: Package Delivery, Mail Services. Prompts: same 120 rows with exactly the same ticks (row-by-row comparison).

results.title: Switching from Brand to Unbranded after the Prompts step clears the brand, markets, categories and prompts

steps.title: Given the user created a brand scope up to the Prompts step
steps.data: Brand: "Decathlon"; market GB (EN); detected categories kept
steps.expected: Prompts shows the suggestions and the pill reads "Brand analysis"

steps.title: When the user goes back to Analysis Type and selects "Unbranded analysis"
steps.expected: The confirmation opens and states that the brand or topic, the markets, the categories and the prompts are cleared

steps.title: And the user confirms
steps.expected: The pill reads "Unbranded analysis"

steps.title: Then Topic & Country starts empty
steps.expected: The topic field is empty, no brand is shown and none of the previous markets is listed

steps.title: And no previous category or prompt is kept
steps.expected: After entering a topic and discovering, Categories and Prompts show only the new topic results

results.notes: Brand scope Decathlon (decathlon.com), GB (EN), detected categories Outdoor Gear + Sports Apparel (+ Overview), 70 prompts, pill 'Brand analysis'. Analysis Type -> Unbranded opens the confirmation with the clear text; Switch type -> pill 'Unbranded analysis'. Topic & Country: empty topic, no brand, no market; later steps locked. After topic 'Postal services' + GB (EN) + discovery: categories Package Delivery / Mail Services, 60 prompts (20/20/20), none referring to Decathlon or its categories.

results.title: Continuing from a valid Topic & Country shows the topic version of the discovery screen

steps.title: Given the user is on Topic & Country with a valid topic and market
steps.expected: "Discover Categories" is enabled

steps.title: When the user clicks "Discover Categories"
steps.expected: The category discovery screen is displayed

steps.title: Then the screen keeps the brand version layout
steps.expected: Same layout as the brand discovery screen (loader and two text lines)

steps.title: And its text is the topic version
steps.expected: The text refers to the topic "Postal services" and does not use the brand text ("Scanning how AI engines see {brand}..." / "We look at your brand...")

steps.title: And discovery ends on Categories
steps.expected: The Categories step opens with the discovered categories

results.notes: Discovery screen: 'Discovering Categories', 'Scanning how AI engines see Postal services across your markets.', 'This usually takes about 20 seconds. We look at your topic, your markets and their languages.' Same structure as the brand screen observed for Decathlon ('...see Decathlon...', '...We look at your brand, ...'; reference screenshot attached). Ends on Categories with Package Delivery and Mail Services. The discover-categories POST was allow-listed (it does not create an analysis).

results.title: Type badges and type selects of an unbranded analysis show Visibility, Competitive, Category Topics or Other
results.error: Step 'And the user opens the type select of a row' - Expected: 'The select lists Visibility, Competitive, Category Topics and Other only'. Observed: the type select of an existing (generated) row lists only 'Visibility', 'Category Topics', 'Competitive' - no 'Other'.

steps.expected: The table is displayed

steps.title: When the user looks at the type badges
steps.expected: Each badge reads Visibility, Competitive or Category Topics

steps.title: And the user opens the type select of a row
steps.expected: The select lists Visibility, Competitive, Category Topics and Other only

steps.title: And the user clicks Add prompt and opens the type select of the new row
steps.expected: The select lists Visibility, Competitive, Category Topics and Other only; no Reputation, no Brand Image

steps.title: When the user confirms the new row with the type empty
steps.data: Prompt: "Which parcel lockers are easiest to use?" - Category C1 - Market GB (EN) - Type empty
steps.expected: The new row badge reads "Other"

results.notes: Badges: Visibility / Competitive / Category Topics only. Row type select (edit mode, Type combobox): Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive, no Other -> FAIL, framed in red in TC-GEO-1241-014_step3_row_select_bug.png. Add prompt row type select: Visibility, Category Topics, Competitive, Other (PASS). New row 'Which parcel lockers are easiest to use?' - Package Delivery - GB (EN) with the type left at its default: badge 'Other' (PASS; the default is already 'Other', not empty). PO question: should 'Other' be selectable on an existing row?

results.title: Review warns that InBrief and Top Topics will not be produced without Category Topics or Other prompts
results.error: Step 'And no prompt is in Other' - Expected: 'The Type and Category filters list no "Other" value'. Observed: both filters list 'Other' with count 0 (Type: Visibility 40, Category Topics 40, Competitive 40, Other 0; Category: Package Delivery 20, Mail Services 20, Other 0).

steps.title: Given the user is on the Prompts step of the unbranded scope
steps.expected: The table is displayed with every suggestion ticked

steps.title: When the user filters on Type Category Topics and unticks every Category Topics prompt
steps.expected: Every Category Topics row is unticked

steps.title: And no prompt is in Other
steps.expected: The Type and Category filters list no "Other" value

steps.title: And the user goes to Review
steps.expected: The Review step is displayed

steps.title: Then the warning names InBrief and Top Topics as metrics the analysis will not produce
steps.expected: The warning names "InBrief" and "Top Topics"

results.notes: All 40 Category Topics rows unticked (1033 / 1000, 80 selected). Review & Launch is disabled while the pool is over, so the 40 FR rows were also unticked to reach Review (adaptation: 993 / 1000, 40 kept = GB Visibility 20 + Competitive 20; the condition 'no Category Topics, no Other' is unchanged). Review: 'No Category Topics prompts are kept, so InBrief and Top Topics will not be produced.' -> names InBrief and Top Topics (PASS, matches en-gb). The step 3 FAIL is literal: 'Other' is listed with 0, likely by design; CSV correction proposed.

results.title: The InBrief and Top Topics warning is not shown when a Category Topics or Other prompt is kept

steps.title: Given every Category Topics prompt of the unbranded scope is unticked
steps.expected: Review shows the InBrief / Top Topics warning

steps.title: When the user goes back to Prompts and adds a kept prompt with the type empty
steps.data: Prompt: "What do people say about parcel lockers?" - Category C1 - Market GB (EN) - Type empty
steps.expected: The row is added ticked with the type "Other"

steps.title: And the user goes to Review
steps.expected: Review is displayed

steps.title: Then the InBrief / Top Topics warning is not shown
steps.expected: No warning names InBrief or Top Topics

steps.title: When the user deletes the Other prompt, ticks one Category Topics prompt and goes to Review
steps.expected: The InBrief / Top Topics warning is still not shown

results.notes: Given: Review shows the InBrief / Top Topics warning (TC-016 state, FR rows unticked for the pool). Added 'What do people say about parcel lockers?' Package Delivery / GB (EN), type default -> row ticked, type 'Other' (994 / 1000, 41). Review: no InBrief / Top Topics warning; an 'Other prompts' block lists the row. Deleted the Other prompt and ticked one GB Category Topics prompt ('What should I look for in Package Delivery?'): Review still without the warning.
